category: Design Software to Meet Security Requirements and Mitigate Risks (PW)
subcategory_text: Document and track security-relevant design decisions and their rationale so that the security posture of the software is traceable.
implementation_examples: Maintain an Architecture Decision Record (ADR) log with security implications
Link design decisions to identified threats and mitigations
Review design decisions at design-review checkpoints
assessment_objectives: Determine whether security-relevant design decisions are documented with rationale.
Determine whether decisions are tracked over the project lifetime.
